Settings.Notifications.Title: Reminders
Settings.Notifications.Lead: Clients get a text before their visit. A reminder that would fall in quiet hours waits until they are over, so nobody is woken up.
Settings.Notifications.QuietHint: No texts are sent between these times. Set both to the same time to switch quiet hours off.
Settings.Notifications.Validation.Second: The second reminder must be closer to the visit than the first.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Title: Cancellations and fees
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Lead: Set how late a client may change or cancel a visit for free, and what a late cancellation or a missed visit costs. Clients see these rules before they book.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.FreeChangeHo: Free changes and cancellation until (hours before the visit)
0 means until the visit starts. Later than this, clients can no longer change the time online and a cancellation counts as late.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.LateFee: Late cancellation fee (% of the price)
Settings.CancellationPolicy.NoShowFeeHin: For a client who does not turn up. 0 means no fee.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Note: Nothing is charged automatically. When a visit is missed or cancelled late, you see the fee and decide whether to add it to the client's account.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Saved: The cancellation policy has been saved.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Validation.P: The percentage must be between 0 and 100.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Validation.L: A late cancellation fee needs a notice period: set the hours above 0.
